citizen.name: Mira Cove
citizen.learned: Mira learned to read the tides and weather from her father, a skilled fisherman.
citizen.lifestyle: Mira rises early to check her nets and spends her evenings mending them by the fire.
citizen.currently: Mira is curious about the new faces in town and hopes to make some new friends.

relationships: Mira and Emmet often share stories of their catches.
Mira admires Ines's dedication to keeping the lighthouse running smoothly.
Mira sometimes sells her catch to Wren's shop.
